info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Capture Updates API
info.description: The Card Capture Updates API enables businesses to modify the details of a previously initiated card capture process. Users can update information related to specific transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with banking regulations. This API is vital for financial institutions and payment processors that need to manage card payment captures efficiently. Typical consumers include banking application developers and compliance teams needing to rectify data or transactional parameters in real time.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific card capture identified by its ID. You can modify various attributes associated with the card capture to ensure the information is current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the card capture details for the specified card. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the schema requirements for successful processing.
